reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount from #shared/schedules, which already implements the missing/number/range-furthest-from-zero rule.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the amount rule stays in its single shared definition.

placement.why: Enrichment sits in the api/schedules-get handler with a dedicated APIScheduleListEntity type; putting it in the API model layer would be equally reasonable.

scope.why: Touches only the list handler, its result type and the existing API test expectations.

maintainability.why: Small, typed, and tied to the canonical amount helper so it stays consistent with the app.
